events.title: Capture only evidence available to each automation
events.summary: A scheduled task must use only the conversations and connected sources actually available to it. Daily rollups should summarize captured event records rather than fabricate a reconstruction of inaccessible conversations or actions.

events.title: Require traceability and verified write acknowledgements
events.summary: The workflow must not expose credentials, unnecessarily copy sensitive data, act outside the authorized scope, or claim delivery without confirmation from the destination. It must preserve traceable record identifiers and disclose unsuccessful writes.
